common: Preserve the specified visual medium and aspect ratio. Do not substitute photorealism for the requested stylization.
Respect the assigned reference roles. Identity references govern the same subject; style and layout examples never supply a replacement identity.
Depict one coherent still image. Do not add unrequested story events, dialogue captions, camera-motion trails or sequential action panels.

character: Maintain one identical subject across the required four views, including face, hair, build, wardrobe, accessories, anatomical asymmetries and holding hand.
location: Establish one connected architectural view with its fixed spatial anchors, without people. Use only the lighting applicable to this location and time.
prop: Show the complete specified object with its stable silhouette, proportions, materials and distinguishing details. No additional subject or collage.
crowd: Preserve the specified people count when given and distinct individual faces and wardrobe; do not clone one person or collapse the crowd into a single identity.
frame: Freeze only the specified moment. Preserve actor-specific pose, eyeline, hand and object ownership, screen direction and spatial relationships. Do not depict a later outcome.
